facts.label: Cost scaling
facts.value: Base cost × 2^(target level − 1), each resource rounded down to whole units.

facts.label: Planet fields
facts.value: Adds 5 fields per completed level, with no even-level bonus. Each level occupies one field, leaving four additional free fields. One free field is required to start.

facts.label: Construction energy
facts.value: 1000 × 2^(target level − 1) gross energy at saved production settings and current fuel availability. Checked before payment at construction start; energy is neither consumed nor reserved. Later power loss does not cancel construction.

facts.label: Demolition
facts.value: Terraformer cannot be demolished. Fields are added only on completion; canceling construction refunds its paid resources without adding capacity.
